name: Assessing the Threat
summary: Deputy Feldon needs a measure of the gnoll threat near Lakeshire. With the garrison stretched thin and Stormwind withholding reinforcements, he hires travelers to thin the packs and learn their strength.

sections.title: A Strained Frontier
sections.body: Lakeshire faces Blackrock orc warbands from the heights and aggressive gnoll packs in the valleys. Its defenders are too few for ordinary scouting patrols. When reports confirmed gnolls pressing toward the border, Deputy Feldon sought help from travelers. He pays champions to test the enemy in the wild, rather than send guards the town cannot spare.

sections.title: Reconnaissance by Force
sections.body: You scout along Redridge's southern road, striking the camps of Redridge Mongrels and Poachers. Each fight thins the gnolls' forward scouts and disrupts their supply lines. It also reveals whether the packs are roaming scavengers or an organized force threatening Lakeshire. The fighting gives Feldon numbers he can use to plan the town's strained defense.

faq.q: Why does Deputy Feldon send adventurers instead of town guards?
faq.answer: Lakeshire's garrison is badly undermanned. Stormwind City sends no reinforcements, and hostile forces press from several directions, leaving the guards unable to spare soldiers for long patrols along the southern road.

faq.q: Where are the gnolls located for this mission?
faq.answer: The Redridge Mongrels and Poachers camp along the southern road and in the low foothills of the Redridge Mountains, south of Lakeshire and near the border passes.

faq.q: What is the strategic purpose of culling these gnolls?
faq.answer: The fighting pushes back gnolls pressing toward the road, disrupts their supply lines, and gives Feldon firsthand intelligence about the packs' size, weapons, and discipline.

faq.q: Does Stormwind City help with the gnoll threat?
faq.answer: No. Stormwind's House of Nobles and regency council withhold regular military support from outlying regions such as Redridge. Local leaders, including Magistrate Solomon and Deputy Feldon, must rely on paid mercenaries.

faq.q: What does Deputy Feldon do with your report?
faq.answer: Deputy Feldon weighs the packs' strength and tenacity, confirming that the southern gnolls pose a serious military danger rather than being isolated beasts. He directs you to help other town leaders shore up their defenses.

faq.q: How does this task connect to the prior quest?
faq.answer: This follows Encroaching Gnolls. After you alerted the garrison to the gnoll movement, Feldon sent you on a combat patrol to learn how serious the incursion is.

angles.text: Redridge shows the strain on the Alliance's heartland: neglected border settlements hire champions to survive while the capital looks away.
As a human defender, protecting Lakeshire is personal. Frontier families bear the cost of political paralysis in Stormwind Keep.
Deputy Feldon calls for armed reconnaissance. As a warrior, you wade into fortified camps and break the gnolls' vanguard.
